create_nevis_stream: create a NevisStream with the FULL variant and a custom stop year for continual learning
create_individual_dataset_stream: create an IndividualDatasetStream for a single dataset like MNIST with train and predict events
create_ablation_stream: create an AblationStream that removes the first 30 tasks from the full NEVIS stream
list_datasets_in_stream: list all dataset names in the SHORT stream variant before year 2020 with duplicates removed
remove_imagenet_from_stream: remove ImageNet from the training portion of a datasets by year mapping before the stop year
